mentions.name: Crypto Helper
mentions.description: This web tool helps debug ASN1-encoded data such as keys, certificates, and Kerberos/CredSSP/SPNEGO data structures, and perform various cryptographic operations. It now supports editing the ASN1 tree directly in the browser and includes a JWT debugger and ASN1 parser; it works online with no sign-in or sign-up required.
mentions.problem: Debugging ASN1-encoded data and protocol implementations is difficult; the tool exists to help with that work.
mentions.audience: Debugging ASN1-encoded data (keys, certificates, Kerberos/CredSSP/SPNEGO structures) and protocol implementations is difficult, so the author built a web tool for this at work.
mentions.source_excerpt: For the last 3 years, I have been working on a web tool to help me at work: debugging ASN1-encoded data (keys, certificates, Kerberos/CredSSP/SPNEGO/etc data structures, and more) and performing various cryptographic operations.
